answer: Counterparty-diversity threshold: an identity earns only after trading with 12 distinct counterparties. Each newcomer anchors its identity to a 40 POA deposit locked in a shared vault, freed after 20 clean epochs. 100 fakes among 5 wallets never reach 12 partners, losing 100 x 40 = 4,000 POA; honest agents pay once and keep full rewards. A bought identity fails too: its narrow ledge of repeat partners is public and flagged before payout.
